title: Japanese-Style Quenched Tagine
description: A twist on traditional Japanese flavors, this dish brings together the warm, comforting spices of North Africa and the freshness of Japanese ingredients.

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: Or sesame oil for added depth

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high.
Add onion and mushrooms; cook until tender.
Add soy sauce, rice vinegar, and maple syrup; stir to combine.
Add quenched tagine and cook until heated through.
Garnish with ginger and serve immediately.
Optional: Add sliced green onions or sesame seeds for extra flavor.
